name: Visual Language Castle Flutter
postCreateCommand: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 /opt/flutter && sudo chown -R $(whoami) /opt/flutter && echo 'export PATH=/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH' >> ~/.bashrc && /opt/flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && cd app && /opt/flutter/bin/flutter pub get
